newsitem.title: CHINA: Rhone-Poulenc signs JV deal with China.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc signs JV deal with China.

text.p: France's Rhone-Poulenc signed a joint venture agreement on Thursday with a pesticide plant in China's eastern city of Hangzhou to turn out products for plant protection, officials said.
Officials said earlier that the agreement, signed as part of a series of deals during a visit by French President Jacques Chirac, would be to produce pesticides to protect rice.
Company officials declined to give details of the value of the deal.
However, officials of Chinese partner Hangzhou General Pesticides Plant gave the value of the deal as 500 million francs ($87.7 million).
Rhone-Poulenc would hold a 75 percent stake in the venture with the Chinese side taking the remaining 25 percent, a Hangzhou company official said.
